At the intersection of data and innovation, I thrive at the heart of adtech, where numbers meet impact. My mission is to transform raw data into strategic insights that drive smarter decisions—because in a world where attention is currency, precision is power.  

Currently, I’m shaping the future of campaign performance at ClickAd Network, where I architect scalable data pipelines that turn terabytes of user interactions into actionable intelligence. My work spans Kafka-powered real-time analytics, Snowflake-based data warehousing, and PostgreSQL-backed dashboards that inform billion-dollar ad spend. I own end-to-end ETL workflows, from Kafka stream processing to Redis-cached microservices, ensuring our clients’ ROI soars while latency shrinks.  

In the past year, I’ve scaled Kafka pipelines to handle 10M+ messages daily, boosting campaign efficiency by 25%. I also pioneered a data modeling framework that reduced query times by 30%, and streamlined dbt pipelines to cut data latency by 40%. These aren’t just numbers—they’re proof that when data is engineered with purpose, it doesn’t just perform—it *transforms*.  

Looking ahead, I seek challenges where my expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native workflows, and real-time analytics can fuel innovation. Let’s build something that doesn’t just keep up with the future—but leads it.
